acceptance_assertion: Boot/build without Codex driver, binary, login or Home; no hidden install or provider fallback.
Preserve native window/theme/keyboard/zoom/accessibility/IME behavior; compare cold/warm performance separately at T47.L.
Keep chat/diff split, resizing, visibility and saved dimensions without provider coupling.
Two views bind explicit public sessions and input targets without duplicate native execution.
Workspace switching, recent ordering and migrated sort metadata preserve scope and attribution.
Only consumption of the correct session/read version clears unread; late/background/cross-project events do not clear it.
Directory, Git and file operations remain usable without connecting a model.
Workspace/public session/native binding/profile versions do not collide; real profile switching also requires T51.N1.
Clone/worktree creation, rename and removal preserve existing modifications and report partial results.
Creating a directory or reading task text does not authorize a launch/setup script; no-Codex startup checked at T02.L.
Composite identity separates native thread ID, instance, account, root, domain and binding generation.
Names/pins/archive/reopen preserve lifecycle; archive is not deletion of native history; migration also T37.L.
Authorized imported history remains readable when native Home is absent; migration/source mapping also T37/T40.
Search/index/copy/export contain only the authorized domain and selected material, not hidden secrets or side chats.
Two composer drafts, attachments, focus and async selection remain independent.
Controller, worker, auditor and global roles do not inherit private conversations by sharing workspace or account.
Chinese IME, shortcuts, streamed focus and normal completion survive rebinding.
Command-like text and mention syntax never grant execution authority or bypass delivery identity.
Picker, native drop, browser drop/paste and FileReader paths freeze the intended original for the chosen target.
Path/asset access respects independent project/product/native domains and protects originals.
Heterogeneous frames including missing thread/turn fields decode with provenance; malformed/partial/gap streams not falsely complete.
Tool/native/model declarations keep their source and failure; model plan text does not invent host execution facts.
Same operation/fingerprint is reconciled, conflicting fingerprint rejected, unknown acceptance not replayed blindly.
Ordinary input cannot starve control; duplicate/late replies cannot revive canceled or terminal operations.
Steer differs from queued send and rejects stale turn/binding targets.
Unsupported/unknown steer remains explicit for each binary/profile/mode; no silent downgrade.
View close, UI disconnect, turn interrupt, session close and host exit are separate outcomes.

Unknown PID identity cannot authorize tree kill; descendants and old writers must be reconciled before replacement. Selected Node close/Room caller: 8s host vs10s grace, codes124/125, repeated-close/missing-handle and descendant-unknown must retain custody (B02).
Approval/input answers bind original request, session, generation and limited scope; remembered rule is a separate write.
Rendered content cannot forge approval controls; sensitive answers excluded from ordinary log/export at T23.L.
Native fork and continuation from fixed visible material are labeled differently and tested separately.
Fork/continuation retains source and cutoff; copied parent history cannot bypass privacy boundaries.
UI folding, generated summary and native compaction remain distinct actions and receipts.
Original history, provenance and recovery mode survive compaction/summary; native Home loss does not imply content deletion.
Review uses fixed Git/material identities; generated report never authorizes merge or adoption.
Formal audit gets a clean binding and selected material, not owner chat, builder context or native fork inheritance.
Model plan, native subagent and host task state are distinct; native subagent is not a public seat authority.
Duplicate/late activity cannot revive canceled tasks or collide across parent/project scopes.
Official login/secret references preserved without token cloning; binding/binary/auth changes invalidate evidence.
Shared account capacity does not imply shared context; neither arbitrary shared Arc nor one-seat-one-account is assumed.
Public model/mode controls consume verified selected-instance capability, not Codex-specific enums as universal truth.
In-flight operations do not silently change account/model/mode when settings or runtime args change.
Cumulative/delta, account sharing, windows and units are distinguished; duplicate events do not double-count.
Unknown usage remains unknown; local JSONL/JWT plan hints are not official remaining allowance.
Public prompt CRUD/parameters work without CODEX_HOME; native execution and target-specific generation are separate checks.
Name conflicts, damaged inputs and repeated imports keep originals and domain identity without accidental execution.
Public AGENTS/rule/config editing does not secretly write provider Home or delete developer files.
Project/native config text does not expand authorization; actual launch inheritance checked at T50.L.
Discovery/view/enable are separate; selected assets carry provenance and license identity.
Importing a skill/plugin cannot execute its scripts or grant new tool authority.
MCP/App status or listing is not cross-provider connection proof.
Connector account secrets and grants do not silently propagate between instances.
Public templates avoid Codex config writes; unknown native fields and external user-managed role files preserved.
Role text cannot assign instances or execution privileges; native agent file editing remains scoped.
PTY create/resize/output/reconnect preserve tabs without duplicate spawn; UI hiding is not process close.
User PTY and model tool processes have separate ownership; OSC52/control sequences also need T54.L.
No-model Git status/diff/branch/commit/clone/worktree/sync remain functional and preserve partial outcomes.
Model prose cannot replace fixed object/path authorization; safe temporary-repo path tests follow at T22.L.
GitHub queries work without model; Ask PR uses fixed material and explicitly selected generation instance.
GitHub credentials do not follow model-account selection; failed generation preserves draft.
Commit message, run metadata and agent description each use a real selected non-Codex instance; manual text is not generated evidence.
All three buttons, context inputs and failure drafts retained; each provider/version checked separately at T30/T62.
Public file tree/search/read/export/open work offline with Chinese and spaced paths.
Product/project/native/asset roots and aliases are independent; file target and renderer tests also T22/T54.
Every launch declares actual program/env/home/cwd and identity; stop result distinguishes parent and descendants.

Reuse requires compatible binding identity and old writer reconciliation, not just a live Arc or DB lease. Selected worker module imports must bind root/writer leases and durable residual receipts before reuse, never release on close Promise or missing handle (B02/B03).
Local IPC reconnect uses version/cursor/gap/snapshot without resending already accepted work through an old route.
Old clients/config/startup/mobile paths cannot restore deferred external remote exposure.
Tray/notification/deep links reauthorize public target and do not falsely clear unread or create another execution.
Private conversation and worker activity do not automatically become owner notification contents or tasks.
Seal status/UI/shortcut/direct command/permission/download/capture entry surfaces; current source is still active.
Keep model bytes/path/hash/config through upgrade/rollback; reactivation separately authorized.

Corrupt JSON/root/schema cannot silently produce empty authoritative data then overwrite originals. Inventory Seat owner/state/transcript/protocol/events/prompts, atomic helper failure/RMW, AccountStore and InstanceStore non-adoption and migration (B03).
Unknown states and usage remain qualified; raw debug/export needs independent secret filtering at T23.L.
Native/OS read-only and inherited environment are tested, not inferred from policy flags or UI checks.
Private upstream/downstream conversations, restoration and old write domains remain isolated from authorized task packages.
Installer/package/worker identity, signed manifest and readiness are individually checked; data import cannot change trust roots.
Upgrade/rollback retains post-upgrade additions; uninstall does not delete user CLI, model or history assets.
Behavior/entry/removal/test/stage/artifact graph has rejection checks; brand checks alone do not prove decoupling.
Fixed candidate, independent pass and owner decision are distinct; author validation cannot become Pass B or production acceptance.
Seal UI/RPC/auto-start/mobile remote entry paths without deleting the local daemon.
Preserve only gogoke-owned remote records; do not copy or mutate external Tailscale identity.
Future structured CLI-to-CLI delegation checks real caller/target/material; no current public delegation completion is claimed.

Worker replies return to controller and formal audit uses clean binding; Room/native subagent cannot bypass public authority. Select symbols, not Room/Seat barrel authority; keep canonical dataRoot/credentialHome and explicit host approval distinct (B03).
